description: This file implements a system notification manager that displays news resource notifications in the Android System Tray. It handles creating and managing notification channels, generating individual notifications with news content, and building summary notifications for multiple news items. It also constructs deep links for news resources and creates pending intents for notification interaction.

classes.name: SystemTrayNotifier
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for posting news notifications to the system tray, including individual news alerts and summary notifications.

methods.name: postNewsNotifications
methods.description: Posts individual news notifications and a summary notification for a list of news resources.

methods.name: newsNotificationStyle
methods.description: Creates an InboxStyle for the notifications summarizing multiple news items.

methods.name: createNewsNotification
methods.description: Creates a configured notification for a news item.

methods.name: ensureNotificationChannelExists
methods.description: Ensures the notification channel exists, creating it if necessary (Android Oreo and above).

methods.name: newsPendingIntent
methods.description: Creates a PendingIntent for a news resource to handle notification clicks.

methods.name: newsDeepLinkUri
methods.description: Builds a deep link URI for a NewsResource.
